output.reason: Evidence supports that the RBI “Pre-payment Charges on Loans” Directions, 2025 (which include Tier 3 Primary (Urban) Co-operative banks being prohibited from levying pre-payment charges on loans up to ₹50 lakh) were withdrawn/repealed with effect from 2025-11-28, and therefore are not in force as of 2026-11-23. However, the evidence does not explicitly state that these earlier Tier 3 UCB directions were “superseded” by a specific replacement set of directions; it only documents withdrawal/repeal.
